name: BRENDA_get_km
description: Get Km (Michaelis constant) values from BRENDA enzyme database. Km indicates substrate affinity - lower Km means higher affinity. Returns values in mM with organism and substrate information. Requires free BRENDA account (register at brenda-enzymes.org/register.php).

BRENDA_EMAIL.purpose: BRENDA account email — retrieves enzyme kinetics, substrates, and parameters.
BRENDA_EMAIL.without: BRENDA tools are blocked without an account (paired with the password).

BRENDA_PASSWORD.purpose: BRENDA account password — authenticates the enzyme-data SOAP API.
BRENDA_PASSWORD.without: Required together with the BRENDA email.

ec_number.description: EC number (e.g., 1.1.1.1 for alcohol dehydrogenase, 2.7.1.1 for hexokinase)

enzyme_id.description: Alias for ec_number. Enzyme identifier in EC notation (e.g., 1.1.1.1).

name: BRENDA_get_kcat
description: Get kcat (turnover number) values from BRENDA enzyme database. kcat is the maximum number of substrate molecules converted to product per enzyme per second. Returns values in 1/s. Requires free BRENDA account.

enzyme_id.description: Alias for ec_number. Enzyme identifier in EC notation (e.g., 1.1.1.1).

error_details.description: Structured detail for the failure, present alongside 'error' whenever ToolUniverse itself refused the call: 'type' (e.g. 'ToolUnavailableError'), 'message', 'retriable' (false for a missing API key -- retrying will not help), 'next_steps' (what the caller can actually do) and 'details'. The error string alone does not say whether a retry is worth attempting.

retriable.description: False when retrying cannot succeed, as for a missing credential.

next_steps.description: Concrete actions that would make the call work.

details.description: Any extra machine-readable context; frequently empty.

name: BRENDA_get_inhibitors
description: Get enzyme inhibitor data from BRENDA. Returns inhibitor names and Ki (inhibition constant) values in mM with organism information. Lower Ki means more potent inhibition. Requires free BRENDA account (register at brenda-enzymes.org/register.php).

enzyme_id.description: Alias for ec_number. Enzyme identifier in EC notation (e.g., 1.1.1.1).

name: BRENDA_get_enzyme_info
description: Get general enzyme information from BRENDA by EC number. Returns enzyme name, systematic name, and catalyzed reaction. Requires free BRENDA account (register at brenda-enzymes.org/register.php).

enzyme_id.description: Alias for ec_number. Enzyme identifier in EC notation (e.g., 1.1.1.1).

name: BRENDA_get_enzyme_kinetics
description: Get comprehensive enzyme kinetic parameters WITHOUT requiring BRENDA credentials. Retrieves enzyme identity (name, catalytic activity, alternative names) from ExPASy ENZYME and kinetic parameters (Km, kcat, Ki, Vmax, kcat/Km) from SABIO-RK. If BRENDA credentials are set (BRENDA_EMAIL, BRENDA_PASSWORD), additionally fetches optimal pH, optimal temperature, and specific activity from BRENDA. Accepts EC number (e.g., 1.1.1.1) or enzyme name (e.g., alcohol dehydrogenase). Returns aggregated summary statistics across all reported values plus individual measurements with substrate specificity and organism information.

ec_number.description: EC number (e.g., 1.1.1.1 for alcohol dehydrogenase, 2.7.1.1 for hexokinase, 3.4.21.5 for thrombin)

enzyme_name.description: Enzyme common name. Will be resolved to EC number via UniProt. Examples: alcohol dehydrogenase, hexokinase, lactate dehydrogenase, thrombin

organism.description: Optional organism filter (e.g., Homo sapiens, Escherichia coli, Saccharomyces cerevisiae)

enzyme_id.description: Alias for ec_number. Enzyme identifier in EC notation.

limit.description: Maximum number of SABIO-RK kinetic law entries to retrieve (default 20)

kinetic_parameters.description: Individual kinetic law entries from SABIO-RK; each has 'parameters' (Km/kcat/Ki/Vmax/kcat-Km values with the substrate they refer to) and 'conditions' (pH, temperature)

type.description: Parameter type (Km, kcat, Ki, Vmax, kcat/Km)

species.description: Compound the constant refers to (e.g. the substrate for a Km), if SABIO-RK names one

value_si.description: SABIO-RK's SI-normalised value, in 'unit_si' (Km in M, kcat in s^(-1))

end_value.description: Upper end when a range is reported

conditions.description: Assay conditions: ph, temperature, temperature_unit (when reported)

ec_number.description: EC number the parameter belongs to, e.g. '1.1.1.1'.

organism.description: Source organism, e.g. 'Saimiri sciureus'. A Km from a squirrel monkey enzyme is not a human Km, and the number alone does not say.

parameter_types.description: Which kinds of parameter the row carries, e.g. ['concentration', ...]. Says whether the row is a Km, a kcat or something else.

products.description: Products of that reaction, e.g. ['beta-NADH', ...] - 8 on the measured row.

pubmed_id.description: PubMed id of the paper the value came from, e.g. '7011375'. The citation for the measurement.

sabiork_entry_id.description: SABIO-RK entry id for the same measurement, e.g. '11794'. The route to the full kinetic record and its assay conditions.

substrates.description: Substrates in the measured reaction, e.g. ['beta-NAD+', ...] - 9 on the measured row. A Km is meaningless without the substrate it was measured for.

tissue.description: Tissue the preparation came from, e.g. 'liver'. Measured on 19 of 20 rows.

parameter_summary.description: Per parameter type (Km, kcat, Ki, Vmax, kcat/Km): count, min, max, median of the SI-normalised values in the returned entries, with their unit; values_in_other_units counts values left out because their unit differs

ph_optima.description: Optimal pH values (BRENDA only, requires credentials)

temperature_optima.description: Optimal temperature values (BRENDA only, requires credentials)

specific_activity.description: Specific activity values (BRENDA only, requires credentials)
